messages:
maya: FYI seeing p99 tail blow up on host-side for small sequences after the kernel-selector change. Affects HTTP/2 ingress.

ben: Confirmed on perf rig. p99 for seq<=64 went 28ms -> ~48ms. Flamegraph top looks like: tokenization->header_parse->encode_small_chunks->writev.

ron: Did kernel selector flip disable continuous batching or change the batching thresholds?

ben: It prefers low-latency kernel for seq<128 which forces single-request execution path, so continuous batching timers rarely fire. Also found many tiny syscalls from small chunk writes.

kai: repro command I used:
```
wrk -t8 -c300 -d20s -s scripts/small-http2-grpc.lua https://edge.local:8443
```
results: p50 6.1ms p95 19.8ms p99 48.3ms, CPU tail shows spikes when KV shard misses occur.

tess: KV cache also surfaces: header auth lookup doing a cold-key lookup on parse path. that adds ~5-12ms jitter when it hits a cold shard.

ben: quick pprof snippet:
```
pprof -top host_preflight.prof
  30.4%  runtime::tokenize_input
  24.7%  request::header_parse
  18.2%  transport::encode_small_chunks
  9.3%   net::writev_syscall
  6.1%   kv::lookup_cold_shard
```

maya: shortlist mitigations we should try in parallel: pool token buffers to avoid per-request allocs, coalesce small chunk writes into fewer writev calls, prewarm KV shard keys for auth header set, and make kernel-selector allow microbatching when load > X.

ron: I can prototype buffer pool and coalesce in the proxy. coalesce will batch writes up to N bytes or T ms. risks: can increase latency for ultra-low-latency 1-packet flows. we can gate behind flag.

b: ben: added a tiny coalesce patch behind flag and a pooled slab for header parsing. Canary on one host (rdx-edge-07): before p99=48.3ms, after coalesce+pool: p99=30.8ms. CPU profile shows 40% drop in tokenization allocations.

kai: with coalesce+pool + KV prewarm on that host, p99 further drops to ~22.5ms. interestingly kernel-selection still matters; when we re-enable continuous batching for seq<=64 (2ms micro-wait), p99 goes down to 18.9ms but p50 increases slightly for some flows.

maya: nice. let's balance: enable coalesce+pool widely, keep KV prewarm, and run an experiment toggling micro-wait 0/1/2/5ms to find sweet spot. Also need to check interplay with http2 flow control and backpressure.

ben: open tickets: LU-501 roll out writev_coalesce rollout and telemetry, LU-502 header-buffer-pool refactor, LU-503 kernel-selector-microbatch-experiment.

infra-bot: deploy 3923456801 by ben started canary on rdx-edge-07 :rocket:

ron: followups for perf matrix: run kernel-selection matrix with seq lengths [8,32,64,128] and batch sizes [1,4,8,32] under small-http2 workload; also measure KV hot vs cold shard behaviour. I'll script it and upload artifacts.

maya: coord with SRE for rollout windows, watch p99/p50/cpu, and pay attention to grpc stream stalls. thanks team, keeping thread for notes.
